regions.label: text
regions.text: The socialistic interpretation of things has grown deep into the heart of society; it grips everyone, great and small alike, and great artists are among the first to feel the influence of its broadening spirit.

regions.label: text
regions.text: Have you studied this picture by Charles Winter?

regions.label: text
regions.text: Have you looked at our frontispiece "The Great Light," by Anton Otto Fischer?

regions.label: text
regions.text: These pictures, painted by two of our comrades, are works of art of which the American Socialist Movement may be proud.

regions.label: text
regions.text: We will send you two beautiful photogravures of these pictures, 12 inches deep and 10 inches wide, with the artist's signature, and tastefully framed.

regions.label: text
regions.text: Then send us two yearly subscriptions, and sign a contract to get us eight more in the next four months or sooner.

regions.label: text
regions.text: We will send the two pictures framed upon receipt of the two subscriptions. If the pictures do not come up to your expectations, return them and we will refund money and cancel subscriptions.
